warning.titlePre: Mercedes GLC220d Injector Seal & Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your GLC220d is an early X253-generation model with the OM651 diesel engine — that's roughly 2015 to 2021 production, before the OM654 was introduced — injector seal leak and timing chain wear is a well-documented pattern shared with the wider C-Class family. We replace injector seals and timing chain components as standard on every OM651 rebuild.
The later X253 models and the current X254 generation use the OM654 engine, a newer design which doesn't share this specific issue.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern, shared with C-Class family, per VRF-mercedes-glc-class.md. OM654 explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to generation
